title: LLM Serving Scheduler from Scratch
blurb: Build the scheduler of an LLM server: cached attention, continuous batching, latency metrics, KV sizing and block allocation, then find and fix a tail-latency problem.
intro: Serving throughput comes from batching many requests through each decode step, and latency comes from how the scheduler orders prefills and decodes. The steps build one cached decode step, a continuous-batching scheduler with a KV budget, the latency metrics (time to first token, time per output token, throughput), the KV cache size per token, and a paged block allocator. The capstone simulates a scheduler on a bursty trace and shows how chunked prefill bounds the inter-token stalls that prefill-first scheduling causes.
